units.title: First-Order Equations
units.blurb: Classify equations and solve linear, exact and substitution-type first-order equations.

units.title: First-Order Models
units.blurb: Build and solve models of mixing, growth, cooling and motion.

units.title: Second-Order Linear Equations
units.blurb: Solve constant-coefficient equations, homogeneous and forced, and model vibrations.

units.title: Laplace Transforms
units.blurb: Turn differential equations into algebra, including steps and impulses.

units.title: Systems of Differential Equations
units.blurb: Solve linear systems with eigenvalues and read phase portraits, then study nonlinear systems.

units.title: Series Solutions
units.blurb: Solve equations with power series near ordinary and singular points.

units.title: Fourier Series and PDEs
units.blurb: Expand functions in Fourier series and solve the heat, wave and Laplace equations.

topics.title: Order, Linearity and Solutions
topics.short: Classify a differential equation and check a proposed solution.
topics.trouble: Students call y′ = y² linear because there is no product of derivatives.

topics.title: Initial Value Problems, Existence and Uniqueness
topics.short: Know when exactly one solution passes through a point.
topics.trouble: Students assume every initial value problem has exactly one solution, missing cases like y′ = √y with y(0) = 0.

topics.title: Linear Equations and Integrating Factors
topics.short: Multiply by e^(∫p dt) so the left side becomes a product's derivative.
topics.trouble: Students use the integrating factor before putting the equation in standard form, or multiply only the left side.

topics.title: Exact Equations
topics.short: M dx + N dy = 0 is exact when My = Nx.

topics.title: Homogeneous and Bernoulli Equations
topics.short: Change variables to reach a separable or linear equation.

topics.title: Autonomous Equations and the Phase Line
topics.short: Equilibria and their stability come from the sign of f(y).
topics.trouble: Students call an equilibrium stable when solutions approach from only one side.

topics.title: Improved Euler and Runge–Kutta Methods
topics.short: Average slopes for much better accuracy.

topics.title: Mixing Problems
topics.short: Rate of change = rate in − rate out.
topics.trouble: Students subtract the outflow rate in liters instead of the amount of salt leaving per minute.

topics.title: Growth, Decay and Newton's Law of Cooling
topics.short: Rate proportional to amount, or to the temperature difference.
topics.trouble: Students forget the surrounding temperature and model the temperature itself as decaying to 0.

topics.title: Population Models with Harvesting
topics.short: Add harvesting to logistic growth and find the new equilibria.

topics.title: Falling Objects with Drag and RC Circuits
topics.short: Model velocity with air resistance and charging circuits.

topics.title: Second-Order Linear Equations and Superposition
topics.short: Combinations of solutions of a homogeneous linear equation are solutions.

topics.title: Independence and the Wronskian
topics.short: Two solutions form a basis when their Wronskian is not zero.

topics.title: Constant Coefficients: Distinct Real Roots
topics.short: Try y = e^(rt) and solve the characteristic equation.

topics.title: Constant Coefficients: Complex Roots
topics.short: e^(αt)(c₁ cos βt + c₂ sin βt) from Euler's formula.
topics.trouble: Students use the whole complex root in the cosine, writing cos((α + iβ)t).

topics.title: Constant Coefficients: Repeated Roots
topics.short: A second solution is te^(rt).
topics.trouble: Students write c₁e^(rt) + c₂e^(rt), which is only one solution.

topics.title: Reduction of Order
topics.short: Use one known solution to find another.

topics.title: Undetermined Coefficients
topics.short: Guess a particular solution shaped like the forcing term.
topics.trouble: Students guess a term that already solves the homogeneous equation and do not multiply by t.

topics.title: Variation of Parameters
topics.short: A general method for any forcing term.

topics.title: Free Vibrations and Damping
topics.short: Underdamped, critically damped and overdamped springs.

topics.title: Forced Vibrations and Resonance
topics.short: Driving near the natural frequency makes the amplitude grow.

topics.title: RLC Circuits
topics.short: The same equation as a damped spring, in electrical form.

topics.title: Higher-Order Linear Equations
topics.short: Extend the characteristic-equation method to order n.

topics.title: The Laplace Transform
topics.short: L{f}(s) = ∫₀^∞ e^(−st) f(t) dt.

topics.title: Transforms of Derivatives and Shifts
topics.short: L{y′} = sY − y(0), and the shift rules.
topics.trouble: Students forget the initial-value terms in L{y″}.

topics.title: Inverse Transforms
topics.short: Use partial fractions and tables to go back to t.
topics.trouble: Students complete the square incorrectly and miss a shifted sine or cosine.

topics.title: Solving Initial Value Problems with Laplace
topics.short: Transform, solve for Y, and invert.

topics.title: Step Functions and Piecewise Forcing
topics.short: Use u(t − c) to switch forces on and off.
topics.trouble: Students write u(t − c)f(t) when the shift rule needs u(t − c)f(t − c).

topics.title: Impulses and the Delta Function
topics.short: Model a sudden kick with δ(t − c).

topics.title: Convolution
topics.short: The transform of a convolution is a product of transforms.
topics.trouble: Students think the transform of a product f·g is the product of the transforms.

topics.title: Systems in Matrix Form
topics.short: Write x′ = Ax, and rewrite a second-order equation as a system.

topics.title: Solving Systems with Real Eigenvalues
topics.short: x = c₁e^(λ₁t)v₁ + c₂e^(λ₂t)v₂.

topics.title: Phase Portraits
topics.short: Nodes, saddles, spirals and centers from the eigenvalues.
topics.trouble: Students decide stability from the eigenvectors instead of the signs of the eigenvalues.

topics.title: Systems with Complex Eigenvalues
topics.short: Real and imaginary parts give spiraling solutions.

topics.title: Systems with Repeated Eigenvalues
topics.short: Find a generalized eigenvector when one is missing.

topics.title: The Matrix Exponential
topics.trouble: Students compute e^(At) by exponentiating each entry.

topics.title: Nonhomogeneous Systems
topics.short: Add a particular solution to the homogeneous solution.

topics.title: Nonlinear Systems and Linearization
topics.short: Classify equilibria with the Jacobian.

topics.title: Predator–Prey and the Pendulum
topics.short: Study classic nonlinear models in the phase plane.

topics.title: Power Series Solutions near Ordinary Points
topics.short: Substitute y = Σaₙxⁿ and find a recurrence.
topics.trouble: Students shift the summation index on one sum but not the others before matching coefficients.

topics.title: Cauchy–Euler Equations
topics.short: Try y = xʳ for x²y″ + axy′ + by = 0.

topics.title: Regular Singular Points and Frobenius
topics.short: Use y = Σaₙx^(n + r) near a regular singular point.

topics.title: Boundary Value Problems and Eigenfunctions
topics.short: Some values of λ allow nonzero solutions with fixed ends.
topics.trouble: Students miss the case λ = 0 or λ < 0 when finding eigenvalues.

topics.title: Fourier Series
topics.short: Write a periodic function as a sum of sines and cosines.
topics.trouble: Students use the wrong interval length in the coefficient formulas.

topics.title: Fourier Sine and Cosine Series and Convergence
topics.short: Extend a function oddly or evenly; the series meets jumps halfway.

topics.title: Separation of Variables
topics.short: Split u(x, t) = X(x)T(t) to get ODEs.

topics.title: The Heat Equation
topics.short: Solve heat flow in a rod with Fourier series.

topics.title: The Wave Equation
topics.short: Model a vibrating string.

topics.title: Laplace's Equation
topics.short: Find steady-state temperatures in a rectangle.
